judging_demo_prompt.prompt: Using your TaskFlow memory tools, what specific work did I do on TaskFlow or Devfolio today? Detail the tools used and cite the exact obsidian daily note.
judging_demo_prompt.expected_behavior: Agent calls query_graph_memory or read_manifest and returns the exact ground truth with tools [[Apps/ghostty]], [[Apps/codium]] and link [[Memory/Daily/2026-09-18]] in ~1.5 seconds.
